prompt:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the four-frame engine-flame loop of the MANTA thruster — the twin-flame grammar of the ray-winged hero ship, in its own green-to-cyan engine ramp, drawn as one clear subject.

Design identity to keep exactly — a single solid engine flame-plume of horizontal fire about 1.4-1.8:1 wider than tall, in the MANTA's cool ramp: one continuous tapered tongue of fire with real body, anchored broad at its nozzle mouth and flowing to a soft rounded tip — a spring-green body (#30c870) with a broad mint inner glow (#a8f8c0) and a near-white heart (#f0fff4) at the nozzle root. The flame sits alone on flat key — no ship, no hardware, no smoke.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 cells laid out as a 2×2 GRID (2-column by 2-row, reading left-right then top-bottom) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject at the same scale and position; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = FRAME 0 LOW BURN — a short stocky plume, compact and rounded: mostly spring green with a small mint inner glow and a near-white heart at the nozzle root. The subject lies within aspect 1.20:1 to 2.10:1.
  cell 2 = FRAME 1 HIGH BURN — the same plume stretched longer and brighter: the mint inner glow broadens along the body and the near-white heart grows toward the rounded tip. The subject lies within aspect 1.20:1 to 2.10:1.
  cell 3 = FRAME 2 SPARK — the short stocky plume again but flickering: a bright bead of spark-light swells at the nozzle root and the tail narrows a little. The subject lies within aspect 1.20:1 to 2.10:1.
  cell 4 = FRAME 3 SURGE — the plume swollen taller at its base: a wide hot root with a broad mint mantle around the near-white heart before it tapers to its single rounded tip. The subject lies within aspect 1.20:1 to 2.10:1.
- FLAME GEOMETRY LAW: the flame-plume's NOZZLE mouth sits well INSET — leave at least 25% of the cell width (about 95 px) as flat key to the RIGHT of the nozzle, and the plume trails LEFT a SHORT distance (the whole flame is stubby, never reaching the left edge — stop 40 px short of it too). The white-hot heart hugs the nozzle. All four cells share the same inset nozzle position, scale and vertical centre.
- SOLID PLUME LAW: each frame shows ONE continuous, THICK flame-plume — a squat, volumetric tongue of fire that fills 60-70% of the cell HEIGHT: a broad round nozzle root, a fat rounded mantle of colour steps, and a single soft blunt tip. The flame is WIDE IN BODY and SHORT IN LENGTH (roughly as tall as it is long, never a long thin streak). Keep a generous flat-key border on all four sides.
- SAME SUBJECT LAW: every cell shows the SAME subject, the same size, the same materials and colours, at the same position in its cell — only the named attitude changes between cells.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 768×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
